unit: T4-U8 product exact-route references (Timoshenko straight member) and the T4-I8 marked re-freezes
status: frozen independent reference before any product comparison; refuted independently on 2026-10-16 with three MINOR findings, two repaired in 5e84d520a7 without a value change; an independent refuter confirmed both repairs on 2026-10-16 and showed that the third finding (an unlisted moved row, TWIN-A Fx) was not a defect: the euler_bernoulli_recovery mutant does not move it, since EA/L is the same in both theories; not product output, not a qualification or acceptance claim
independence: generators/u8_reference.py imports, reads and runs no product code; expected values are this generator's exact arithmetic, never product observations

sources.physics: SHEAR_REFERENCE at f2211ecef6 (CONTRACT.md sections 1-5, INDEPENDENT_REFUTATION.md, _run_records/shear_refutation/reference_arithmetic.py and stdout)
sources.t4_i8: repaired T4-I8 freeze at 5b07d85cf3 (tracked copy validation/references/t4_i8/), with T4-RV4's S-2 re-freeze marks

numeric_representation.exact: authoritative; Q(pi) text forms 'p', 'p/q', 'r*pi', 'r/pi', 'r*pi^k', '(n0 + n1*pi + ...)/(d0 + d1*pi + ...)', and 'sqrt(...)' for a norm outside Q(pi)
numeric_representation.decimal: 40 significant digits from the exact form (pi by Machin, 140-digit context)
numeric_representation.expected: binary64 rounding of the exact value converted into the row unit; never a product value
numeric_representation.inputs: S-B, S-E, rotated, dual-basis and load-state cases use their decimal inputs as exact rationals (ri = 9/100 m); the requests author the nearest binary64 values (relative effects of order 1e-16). Twin A uses the fixture's exact binary64 inputs, as the fixture does

criteria.negative: for every discriminator row: |observed - wrong| > 1e-9 max(|observed|, |wrong|); every listed wrong value is separated from the expected value by more than 1e-7 relative

row_conventions.key: (kind, entity_ref, location, component) and section_basis on stress rows; basis_ref is the load case
row_conventions.stress_rows: published once per section basis (nominal_section then reduced_section); with zero mill tolerance and allowance both carry the same value
row_conventions.end_rows: element_local force rows at end_i/end_j: node-on-element end actions, element-local DOF sense (T4-I8 section 1)
row_conventions.station_rows: quarter_1/midspan/quarter_3: the section-cut action on the +x face of the i-side segment
row_conventions.stress: element_local stress rows (MPa) at all five locations from the +x-face section action: axial N/A_b, bending M_y/Z_b and M_z/Z_b, torsional T r_o/J_b
row_conventions.maximum: pipe_elastic_normal_stress_maximum_v2 (Pa, governing_station): max over the member of |N/A_b| (|Nw/A_b| when pressurized) + hypot(M_y, M_z)/Z_b
row_conventions.pressure_rows: pressurized members: pipe_wall_axial_force_v2 = Nw, pipe_effective_axial_force_v2 = Nw - pAi, membrane Nw/A_b and Lame rows per basis, pipe_wall_endpoint_action_v2 -Nw/+Nw; no element_local_axial_* rows (T4-I8 section 1)
row_conventions.displacements: global, mm; rotations global, rad, the Timoshenko section rotation theta
row_conventions.reactions: support_reaction_component_v2: support-on-pipe, global, R = K u - f; a spring's reaction is -k u in its DOF; magnitudes are the force and moment norms
row_conventions.status: on Timoshenko cases each row states shear_model: shear_dependent or same_as_euler_bernoulli (against the document's own Euler-Bernoulli solve); I8 and twin-A rows also state their T4-I8 / fixture standing
row_conventions.inferred: element_local_axial_force and element_local_axial_normal_stress (unpressurized members) follow the pattern of the other element_local kinds (component = kind without the element_local_ prefix; N and MPa; end rows node-on-element). T4-I8 records no row of these two kinds; they are nonzero only in the rotated cases

discriminator_catalogue.euler_bernoulli_despite_timoshenko: the Timoshenko selection ignored: the Euler-Bernoulli element (shear omitted)
discriminator_catalogue.timoshenko_despite_euler_bernoulli: shear deformation applied to a document that selects euler_bernoulli
discriminator_catalogue.cowper_factor: Cowper's displacement-average annulus factor kappa_C in place of the energy-matched kappa_E
discriminator_catalogue.solid_circle_cowper_factor: the solid-circle Cowper factor 6(1+nu)/(7+6nu) (39/44 at nu = 0.3)
discriminator_catalogue.solid_circle_energy_factor: the solid-circle energy factor 6(1+nu)^2/(7+14nu+8nu^2) (kappa_E at m = 0)
discriminator_catalogue.unit_shear_factor: kappa = 1 (shear area equal to the metal area, as Code_Aster's SSLL106)
discriminator_catalogue.theta_equals_slope: the published nodal rotation is the centreline slope v' = theta + V/Ks instead of the section rotation theta (rows at unrestrained nodes where V is single-valued)
discriminator_catalogue.linear_element: the fully integrated equal-order linear v/theta element (shear locking; its consistent transverse load vector [wL/2, 0, wL/2, 0])
discriminator_catalogue.swapped_plane_signs: the x-z plane mapped with theta = +ry (the x-y plane's sign pattern) instead of theta = -ry
discriminator_catalogue.kappa_on_GJ: the shear factor applied to the torsional rigidity: GJ -> kappa G J
discriminator_catalogue.shear_area_in_EA: the shear area in the axial rigidity: EA -> E kappa A (axial stiffness only; eigenloads keep the metal area)
discriminator_catalogue.euler_bernoulli_recovery: stiffness-only replacement: Timoshenko K assembled and solved, member end actions recovered with the Euler-Bernoulli K (f = K_EB d - feq); support reaction rows shown as a product would recover them from those end actions
discriminator_catalogue.kappa_on_reduced_section: kappa and A_s formed on the reduced section (wall - mill - allowance) instead of the stiffness (nominal) section
discriminator_catalogue.stiffness_on_reduced_section: stiffness (A, I, J) and the shear area on the reduced section
discriminator_catalogue.stiffness_pre_d5: stiffness and the shear area on wall - mill tolerance (the pre-D-5 single section)
discriminator_catalogue.reduced_rows_copied_from_nominal: one basis for both stress families (each reduced row equals its nominal twin)
discriminator_catalogue.base_nu_for_kappa: kappa_E from the material's base nu instead of the load case's resolved nu (G resolved)
discriminator_catalogue.base_nu_for_kappa_and_G: kappa_E and the G of Ks from the base nu (E resolved per case)
discriminator_catalogue.first_case_shear_reused: the first load case's kappa_E and G (hence Ks) reused for every load case

stale_euler_bernoulli_load_vector: stale_euler_bernoulli_load_vector (the distal-half EB vector with Timoshenko K: tip v 54/384 instead of 53/384) is an element-level discriminator (element_controls.json S-A): the exact route has no partial-span member load (design section 3.4), and for the only admitted member load, full-span uniform, the exact Timoshenko vector equals the Euler-Bernoulli vector, so no product-route row can expose it
